- This power has been repeatedly abused

- Democratic societies typically find tolerance + counter-speech more effective than suppression

- Distinguish between *beliefs* (which are hard to suppress effectively) and *dangerous actions*
- Address root causes of radicalization
- Engage in robust counter-speech and public debate
- Maintain legal standards against incitement to violence
